- lesson: nonempty string
- evidence_refs: array[string]
- unresolved_questions: array[string]
- uncertainty: nonempty string
- recommended_state_transition: nonempty string
ID ARRAY RULES:
- array values for evidence/ref fields must be exact IDs, never evidence summaries or prose
- evidence_refs values must be chosen from: exp-a_evidence_1, exp-a_contrary_1
TASK: perform only operation summarize_learning. Allowed transition/next-operation values: summarize_learning, select_next_focus. For recommended_state_transition or recommended_next_operation, copy exactly one allowed value with no new label. Use evidence_refs only from evidence_for IDs: exp-a_evidence_1. Contrary evidence may inform the summary, but do not add a contrary_evidence_considered field Empty strings are invalid for required text fields. The uncertainty value must be a nonempty phrase naming what remains unresolved. Do not copy field descriptions as answers. Do not claim the loop, task, system, or episode is successful or complete. Do not choose declare_insufficient_evidence when both evidence_for and contrary_evidence are supplied.
